dataPolicy: Only public research datasets; no app-user records.

datasets.name: CMU Keystroke Dynamics Benchmark
datasets.license: Public research dataset; cite Killourhy & Maxion (2009).
datasets.method: Median H.* hold time per participant, then equal-weight participant percentiles; seconds converted to ms.
datasets.limits: Fixed-password authentication task. No disease or fatigue labels. Context only; not a healthy-person or clinical threshold.

datasets.name: Tappy Keystroke Data v1.0.0
datasets.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
datasets.method: Median valid hold time per participant (at least 100 events; 0 < hold <= 1000 ms), then equal-weight participant percentiles.
datasets.limits: Self-reported labels, uncontrolled devices and tasks, selection and medication confounders. Pooled cohort reference only in the app; no diagnostic cutoff or accuracy claim.

datasets.name: SWELL-KW computer-interaction minute features
datasets.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (research benchmark artifact only; noncommercial share-alike attribution applies).
datasets.method: Condition N/I/T rows only (relax R excluded); mean minute count per participant and condition, then equal-weight participant percentiles.
datasets.limits: Task/context reference, not burnout, depression, migraine, or a millisecond flight-volatility label. Event definitions differ from this recorder; rates are not interchangeable.

notIncluded.name: Generic Kaggle fatigue/biometrics datasets
notIncluded.reason: No identified, licensed dataset with matching labels and event definitions was verified.

notIncluded.name: Generic Hugging Face cognitive-fatigue datasets
notIncluded.reason: Platform listings and reproduction results are not interchangeable with verified labeled keystroke data.
